THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
106
STUDY 093
Blue Raglan Knit & Concho Belt
Rights check
Source: 24980.jpg
Edgy, bohemian, layered
WORKING NOTES
- The marled sleeves and concho belt are the defining
textures.
- Keep the swirl motif specific to match the knit detail.
Try this: Describe the swirl motif precisely.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight black hair and side-swept layers
wears a brown knit raglan top with a
blue swirl motif and blue-and-brown
marled sleeves. A black choker and
layered silver chain necklaces sit at her
throat. A flowing olive-green tiered maxi
skirt is cinched with a silver concho
chain belt. Her expression is calm and
direct. A plain pale gray backdrop with
soft light. Palette of chocolate, cerulean
blue, olive, and silver. Edgy and
bohemian, in the style of an alternative
knitwear lookbook.
